::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Planned, from the syllabus"}
Delete this block once the lesson is drafted.

> - Stack pure 3:2 fifths twelve times. You land near seven octaves and miss by an audible margin.
> - Equal temperament divides the octave into twelve equal ratios of 21/12 and spreads that error everywhere.
> - Play a just major third against an equal-tempered one. The difference is small, real, and now you can hear it.
>
> **Ends with: the same triad in just intonation and equal temperament, back to back.**
:::
